scenes.title: Identity construction
scenes.reference: Faint radial construction lines on warm off-white. Gray circles accumulate around a ring; connected shapes fill with near-black ink.
scenes.xem: Construct the actual Xem mark from its two circles, two rounded squares, and connecting necks. Preserve the reference's center, construction-diagram scale, and sequential fill rhythm.
scenes.purpose: Introduce Xem as a designed, connected system.
keyframes: Opposite anchor and square modules begin forming.
The entire gray mark is readable.
Connections resolve and construction motion settles.
Finish the ink sweep; prepare the wordmark reveal.
scenes.motion: Shape paths and connecting necks share the original geometry; guide endpoints and fill masks are seekable. Match acceleration from the source's frame sequence. Do not turn the Xem mark into Cyera's ring.
scenes.handoff: The symbol survives into scene 02; its world position and velocity must be sampled from frame 40 and carried into frame 41.
scenes.review: The construction motion changes because Xem's mark has different geometry. Identity correctness wins over copying Cyera's final silhouette.

scenes.title: Wordmark resolves
scenes.reference: The symbol moves left as the lowercase cyera wordmark resolves from a partial reveal. The complete dark lockup holds on cream.
scenes.xem: Resolve the real symbol beside the site wordmark ‘Xem’, preserving the source's overall lockup footprint and optical centering.
scenes.purpose: Make the brand recognizable immediately.
keyframes: Reveal begins while the symbol shifts left.
All three letters are fully visible.
scenes.motion: A horizontal mask and a short position settle; use the site's capital X. Adjust tracking and mark-to-type gap rather than stretching letters.
scenes.handoff: Preserve the exact lockup into scene 03; only measurement graphics are added.
scenes.review: Final type bounds must be measured against the source at full size after the Xem wording is fitted.

scenes.title: Clear-space study
scenes.reference: Lime top/bottom bars and then vertical side bars measure the logo clear space. Fine markers and guides sit around the lockup.
scenes.xem: Use Xem lemon for the same horizontal-then-vertical clear-space sequence around the Xem lockup.
scenes.copy: Xem; tiny x-unit measurement labels only.
scenes.purpose: Carry the reference's precise brand-system character.
keyframes: Last light-frame hold before the dark cut.
scenes.motion: Straight edge wipes with the source's spacing rhythm; keep guides secondary to the mark.
scenes.handoff: Hard cut at frame 83; do not add a dissolve.
scenes.review: Clear-space units are a film graphic, not a claim that a formal public Xem identity manual exists.

scenes.title: Dark identity and escaping dot
scenes.reference: A smaller cream lockup sits on a very dark ground with fine moving guide lines. The mark dims; one pale node separates and travels toward the upper left.
scenes.xem: Cream Xem lockup on ink. One circular module separates from the mark and becomes the transition dot.
scenes.purpose: Establish the dark identity and make one shape carry the story forward.
keyframes: Cut to the smaller cream lockup.
Fine guide lines travel behind it.
The circle reaches the upper-left transition position.
scenes.motion: Keep the reference's longer held interval, then accelerate the departing circle. Avoid adding an unrelated background loop.
scenes.handoff: Circle position, size, and tangent at 125 must align with the dark stroke entering scene 05 at 126.
scenes.review: The surviving circle must visibly originate from the Xem mark.

scenes.title: Dot becomes color
scenes.reference: Hard switch to pale lavender; a short dark arc contracts into a dot that settles near the center.
scenes.xem: Use the escaped Xem module for the same arc-to-dot contraction on pale lavender.
scenes.purpose: Bridge identity geometry into the brand palette without a dead cut.
keyframes: Arc enters on the light ground.
scenes.motion: Animate the arc geometry, translation, and radius together; preserve the short deceleration.
scenes.handoff: Scene 06 starts from this dot and expands it into the iris swatch.
scenes.review: Do not insert a title or extra beat here; this is a 17-frame transition.

scenes.title: Palette grid
scenes.reference: The dot grows into a purple rounded square. Neighboring colors populate a large grid that drifts vertically, revealing neutral and bright swatches.
scenes.xem: Populate the same swatch composition with Ink #22251f, Iris #5b3cc4, Forest #164b3f, Cream #ffffef, Lemon #edf09b, and Lavender #e7d8fa. Repeat partial edge swatches where the source grid extends off-screen.
scenes.copy: Color names and exact Xem hex values.
scenes.purpose: Translate the reference palette study into Xem's own visual system.
keyframes: The center dot becomes an iris swatch.
First card reaches its rounded-square shape.
Top and lower rows enter the crop.
scenes.motion: Preserve card corner ratios, stagger, grid spacing, and the source's final upward drift. Labels stay attached to their swatches.
scenes.handoff: Hard cut at frame 192 into oversized typography.
scenes.review: All names and hex values come from the website theme; no new palette names are invented.

scenes.title: Oversized type field
scenes.reference: Huge black type on a purple field deliberately crops at the edges: ‘from promise / to impact. / The archite…’. Individual words highlight lime and change from sans to serif.
scenes.xem: Keep the oversized crop and word emphasis, using ‘From a message / to a connection. / Make it your own.’ The active phrase changes from DM Sans to EB Garamond in the same rhythmic slot.
scenes.copy: From a message / to a connection. / Make it your own.
scenes.purpose: State the shift from sending messages to building relationships.
keyframes: Serif phrase holds within the sans field.
scenes.motion: Use glyph swaps/masks rather than font interpolation that changes the line unpredictably. Preserve intentional overscan; do not shrink the whole field to fit.
scenes.handoff: Hard cut at 226 to the structured type specimen.
scenes.review: This is proposed Xem copy; the source's exact words do not describe Xem.

scenes.title: Type pairing statement
scenes.reference: Large purple sans letters assemble ‘Protect / your data.’ against a dark design grid. ‘Secure AI.’ arrives below, flashes lime, and changes to a light serif.
scenes.xem: Use the same three-line, offset hierarchy: ‘Every / email. / More human.’ The first two lines are DM Sans; the last line changes to EB Garamond, then holds in lavender.
scenes.purpose: Make the human quality of Xem's email tools the main promise.
keyframes: ‘Every’ is present; outline guides indicate the remaining lines.
‘More human.’ arrives on the lower baseline.
Lower line receives the lemon highlight.
Lower line switches to the editorial serif.
scenes.motion: Character masks follow the source timing. Keep the lower line's offset, large scale, and grid annotations. Type-family notes use the real Xem fonts.
scenes.handoff: Hard cut at 282; keep the dark ground's color consistent.
scenes.review: Brand copy is compact enough for the original reading time; no feature list is inserted.

scenes.title: Corner-radius macro
scenes.reference: A close-up of one purple panel corner, with a lime control point and construction grid; the radius grows as the camera shifts.
scenes.xem: Rebuild that exact design-detail beat with an iris panel, lemon control point, and a radius that echoes Xem's rounded modules and editor cards.
scenes.purpose: Connect identity geometry to the product's visual surfaces.
scenes.motion: Animate vector radius and camera crop together. Control point follows the corner mathematically.
scenes.handoff: Match the enlarged corner to the full rounded viewport beginning at 305.
scenes.review: Measure the source radius in the layout pass; this plan records timing and geometry intent, not an already-verified pixel match.

scenes.title: Viewport pulls back
scenes.reference: The camera snaps back to a large rounded purple viewport, with small handles at its corners.
scenes.xem: Use the same rounded frame and pullback, now iris on Xem ink. This viewport will become the first illustrated email world.
scenes.purpose: Turn the brand's geometry into a storytelling canvas.
keyframes: Pull back to the entire viewport.
Final empty window before the landscape is drawn.
scenes.motion: One fast camera pullback with a controlled settle; do not stretch this 11-frame breath.
scenes.handoff: Identical window bounds, corner radius, and handles continue into scene 11.
scenes.review: No logo or headline is added during this transition.

scenes.title: Illustrated world appears
scenes.reference: A purple horizon lights up inside the viewport. Terrain contours and foreground shelves draw forward from the distance; construction guides and a tiny brand mark appear.
scenes.xem: Rebuild the layered horizon and terrain in iris/lavender, preserving the source's horizon height and depth. Use subtly folded paper contours to connect this world to email. Add the Xem lockup in the source's small lower position.
scenes.purpose: Give email a visual world beyond interface screenshots.
keyframes: Land on the completed illustrated viewport.
scenes.motion: Layered SVG/2.5D terrain with coordinated depth, not a flat image zoom. Halftone Field supplies a masked light sweep under the sky, with the original silhouette retained.
scenes.handoff: Keep horizon and central framing into the palette-change cards of scene 12.
scenes.review: Halftone is an intentional added texture; its contrast must stay below the landscape and type. Landscape layers are still to be authored.

scenes.title: Newsletter cover variants
scenes.reference: ‘New Release’ appears over three rapid terrain/color treatments. The last blue-and-green layout settles into a rounded card.
scenes.xem: Use ‘Your next newsletter’ in the same editorial headline position. Cycle cream/iris, lavender/forest, then forest/ink worlds while retaining the source's 5-frame, 3-frame, then held rhythm.
scenes.purpose: Make the illustrated brand world a recognizable email design use case.
keyframes: Card is ready to pull back into the montage.
scenes.motion: Hold headline anchor through every color cut. No crossfades between variants.
scenes.handoff: The final cover remains the central card of scene 13; preserve its content and transform.
scenes.review: ‘Your next newsletter’ is proposed copy; it is not a product-release announcement.

scenes.title: Whole email world montage
scenes.reference: The cover shrinks as rounded panels populate a dense mosaic: interfaces, icon objects, landscapes, and brand applications. The camera reveals a larger system.
scenes.xem: Keep that pullback and mosaic layout. Populate it with the actual editor, newsletter workspace, automation canvas, audience, analytics, forms, and designed cover panels. Circle Carousel 4 runs inside the template-gallery tile using twelve existing Xem template previews.
scenes.copy: No new master headline. Tiny labels: Design, Send, Automate, Understand where the source has UI labels.
scenes.purpose: Show that the canvas, audience, timing, and results live in one workspace.
keyframes: Top center template tile becomes visible.
scenes.motion: One shared camera pullback and staggered tile arrivals. Start the carousel from an already-populated circular layout; use its fast-slow-fast swing within the original 48-frame slot, not a six-second inserted scene.
scenes.handoff: Hard cut at 415 to the white sketch board.
scenes.review: Use the exact carousel-circle-4 block, not carousel-circle-5 or a text-carousel variant. This nested carousel is a deliberate difference from the reference. Existing screenshots show sample workspace data.

scenes.title: Mail-capsule sketch
scenes.reference: A small wireframe pod rotates against an off-white construction grid. Its silhouette has a rounded body and framed windows.
scenes.xem: Keep the pod scale, rotation, and framing, but build a mail capsule whose seam resembles an envelope fold and whose ports echo Xem's circle-to-square modules.
scenes.purpose: Introduce the traveling message as the recurring visual character.
keyframes: Wireframe capsule appears on the construction grid.
Body turns through its side view.
Front fold/seam comes back into view.
scenes.motion: A single 3D model drives both its wireframe and shaded forms so the silhouette does not jump at the material reveal.
scenes.handoff: Identical camera, mesh, and transform continue at frame 444; only materials and environment change.
scenes.review: This is a new Xem illustration, not an invented software feature or assistant character.

scenes.title: Capsule gains a world
scenes.reference: The pod gains purple and peach materials. A pastel sky washes in, followed by left/right canyon walls and green foreground terrain.
scenes.xem: Resolve the capsule in iris, lavender, and cream; construct the same layered canyon shot with forest foreground and the same left/right occlusion order.
scenes.purpose: Move from the designed object into a living email journey.
keyframes: Material fill appears on the wireframe.
The complete world holds for traversal.
scenes.motion: Layer reveals use the source's order and short timings. A clipped Halftone Field light band sits behind the sky, never over the capsule edges.
scenes.handoff: The capsule and every terrain layer remain in place at the start of scene 16.
scenes.review: Keep the precise silhouette and depth hierarchy even though the colors and object details become Xem's.

scenes.title: Travel through the canyon
scenes.reference: The pod drifts left through a layered canyon, rotates, and then rises into the upper field while the landscape recedes.
scenes.xem: Fly the mail capsule along the same path. It carries a folded email shape internally, with no labels competing with the motion.
scenes.purpose: Make movement and connection tangible.
keyframes: Capsule nears the left canyon edge.
Capsule scales down as it rises.
It reaches the high position for the beam.
scenes.motion: One camera and a sampled capsule trajectory; terrain parallax follows depth. Preserve the source's direction changes rather than using a generic orbit.
scenes.handoff: Carry capsule pose and position into scene 17 without a jump.
scenes.review: Exact x/y/scale/rotation samples must be recorded during the layout/animation pass; the frame timings here are already fixed.

scenes.title: A message in the light
scenes.reference: A narrow vertical beam opens into a large cone under the pod; a tiny cube floats inside the light.
scenes.xem: Preserve the narrow-to-wide light cone. Replace the cube with a small folded email card whose shape is readable without an icon label.
scenes.purpose: Give the traveling object a concrete email payload.
keyframes: Folded email payload appears inside the cone.
Payload and capsule continue their small coupled movement.
scenes.motion: Use a deterministic volumetric cone or layered transparent geometry with the source's falloff and floor reach. Payload stays on the beam axis.
scenes.handoff: Keep the beam and payload anchor through the world changes in scene 18.
scenes.review: The beam is an illustration of connection, not a guarantee of delivery or inbox placement.

scenes.title: World changes and line bridge
scenes.reference: Three worlds flash beneath the same beam: red canyon, purple landscape, green valley. The pod departs; perspective rays converge at the horizon.
scenes.xem: Preserve the same terrain cuts using cream/iris, lavender, and forest worlds. The message leaves; guide lines remain and become the next scene's geometry.
scenes.purpose: Connect the visual journey to Xem's reusable system of tools.
keyframes: Capsule leaves the frame; beam reduces to rays.
Final landscape frame before the dark match cut.
scenes.motion: Keep the scene-switch frames exact. Convergence point is the continuity anchor into the icon seed.
scenes.handoff: The ray intersection and ray angles at frame 547 must match their dark-background continuation at 548.
scenes.review: No extra scene or explanatory caption fits this rapid transition.

scenes.title: Icon seed
scenes.reference: The perspective rays persist on a dark field, then shrink into a small geometric star/diagram.
scenes.xem: Use that match cut to make a small connection/automation-node diagram. Retain the source's off-center placement and shrink timing.
scenes.purpose: Turn the illustrated world into the product's functional vocabulary.
keyframes: Dark match cut; rays remain aligned.
Hold the seed before adjacent icons arrive.
scenes.motion: A shared vector path group shrinks with its line width compensated. Draw endpoint circles in the source's sequence.
scenes.handoff: Seed diagram remains at its grid slot when scene 20 populates the surrounding cells.
scenes.review: Line weights need full-resolution review; thumbnails alone are insufficient for this shot.

scenes.title: Icon system expands
scenes.reference: Geometric outline icons arrive around the seed. The grid expands from a few icons to a dense field as the camera pulls back.
scenes.xem: Use a cohesive thin-line family based on real Xem concepts: envelope, editable blocks, calendar, automation branch, contact group, form, chart, inbox, code brackets, and webhook. Repeat visual variants to match the source's dense field.
scenes.purpose: Show the breadth of the workspace without a rapid feature checklist.
scenes.motion: Use one shared pullback; paths draw or rotate in place on the exact source entry beats. Avoid independently floating icons.
scenes.handoff: Hard cut at 637 to the laptop scene.
scenes.review: Repeated visual variants are not separate product features; do not label the field with an invented feature count.

scenes.title: The real website on a laptop
scenes.reference: A laptop sits on dark terrain against a purple sunset. The camera pushes in while the site inside the screen scrolls to the hero.
scenes.xem: Use the real xem.email page inside a screen-accurate laptop mockup. Follow the same push-in and page travel, landing on the actual ‘Every email, a little more human’ hero.
scenes.purpose: Anchor the abstract brand film in the real product and its public promise.
keyframes: Page begins traveling toward the hero.
Headline becomes the screen's main feature.
Hero artwork and heading are fully visible.
scenes.motion: Capture the real page at adequate resolution, texture it into a calibrated screen plane, and animate its crop. Laptop perspective and camera motion follow the source.
scenes.handoff: Hard cut at frame 679 to the first physical application.
scenes.review: The live text was read, but the final 1920-wide screenshot and laptop asset still need capture/creation. Do not invent a screenshot.

scenes.title: Physical brand triptych
scenes.reference: A floating cream cap appears, then a poster, then a black sweatshirt, each in its own vertical panel with soft grounding shadows.
scenes.xem: Preserve cap → poster → sweatshirt and the three-panel layout. Apply the actual Xem mark to the cap, the mail-capsule world to the poster, and the thin-line icon family to the sweatshirt.
scenes.copy: Xem on the artwork where the source carries its logo.
scenes.purpose: Complete the brand-system showcase with tangible applications.
keyframes: Hold triptych before the next cut.
scenes.motion: Match object turns, entry order, panel proportions, and floating shadow size. Reuse the same artwork developed for earlier scenes.
scenes.handoff: Hard cut at 712.
scenes.review: These are proposed brand-application mockups, not merchandise currently sold by Xem. Photographic/3D assets have not been produced yet.

scenes.title: Newsletter lockup
scenes.reference: The Cyera logo extends into ‘cyera research labs’ against a blue/green horizon, with thin alignment annotations around the wordmark.
scenes.xem: Use ‘Xem newsletters’ in the same expanding descriptor lockup against a forest/iris horizon. Retain the fine typography annotations.
scenes.purpose: Show the recurring email use case in the reference's brand-family rhythm.
scenes.motion: The Xem mark is the fixed anchor. Descriptor length determines spacing; the landscape stays subtly alive as in the source.
scenes.handoff: Same brand anchor continues at frame 746 while the descriptor and terrain switch.
scenes.review: This is a descriptor of an existing Xem feature, not a fabricated research organization.

scenes.title: Automation lockup
scenes.reference: Hard cut to ‘cyera school of ai’ over a warmer canyon world, with the same logo anchor.
scenes.xem: Switch to ‘Xem automations’ against the cream/iris world, maintaining identical anchor and baseline.
scenes.purpose: Connect the journey motif to Xem's visual automation builder.
keyframes: Final hold before the next descriptor.
scenes.motion: A clean source-timed cut with minimal internal motion; only 15 frames are available.
scenes.handoff: Preserve mark anchor and baseline into scene 25.
scenes.review: Do not add supporting copy or animate a full workflow in this half-second shot.

scenes.title: Open-source lockup
scenes.reference: ‘cyera community’ appears over a lilac sunset landscape in the same lockup position.
scenes.xem: Use ‘Xem open source’ over the lavender world. Preserve the consistent brand anchor and the short read.
scenes.purpose: State Xem's verifiable open-source identity.
scenes.motion: One clean cut; terrain motion continues at the reference's pace.
scenes.handoff: Hard cut to the final hero world at 775.
scenes.review: No community-size, adoption, or customer claim is added.

scenes.title: Make email more human
scenes.reference: The pod flies through a dark purple world with floating stones and a curved foreground rim. Large white type builds ‘Secure / the unknown’, then holds while the pod turns and departs.
scenes.xem: Recreate the same foreground rim, depth, floating objects, and capsule trajectory. Use ‘Make email / more human.’ in the same two-line typographic role. Small email fragments replace the loose cubes.
scenes.purpose: Resolve the entire film into a memorable human-centered brand promise.
keyframes: Cut into the deep hero world; capsule is in motion.
Hold the statement while the object continues its source path.
Last hero frame before the closing cut.
scenes.motion: Use the same layered camera and capsule animation, with type held steady during the read. Halftone Field may supply the masked rear glow; preserve clean letters and the original object silhouettes.
scenes.handoff: Capsule departure leads into the crossing object at frame 844; match model, material, and rotation direction across the cut.
scenes.review: Two-line wording is deliberately shorter than the full website tagline so it fits the source's layout and reading time.

scenes.title: Capsule returns to identity
scenes.reference: A dim small logo appears on dark. The pod sweeps in large from the left, shrinks beneath the mark, then disappears into the brightened final lockup.
scenes.xem: Use the same scale change and crossing path to bring the capsule back to the Xem mark. Resolve the mark in lemon with cream wordmark.
scenes.purpose: Close the visual loop from brand geometry to traveling message and back.
keyframes: Dark end-card begins with dim identity.
Large capsule crosses from the left.
Capsule has resolved into the final identity.
scenes.motion: Follow the source's brief overscale crossing and fast shrink. The capsule may collapse into a circular module; the final logo must exactly match the supplied Xem geometry.
scenes.handoff: The entire lockup remains unchanged into scene 28.
scenes.review: No additional logo sting, particle explosion, or unrelated effect is appended.

scenes.title: Final brand hold
scenes.reference: Small green-and-cream Cyera lockup holds at center on a dark field through the final source frame.
scenes.xem: Hold the lemon-and-cream Xem lockup at the same relative scale and center. Keep the dark field calm.
scenes.purpose: Leave a clear final brand impression.
keyframes: Final decoded reference frame; end after this frame.
scenes.motion: Static hold. No fade to black or extra CTA is added because neither is in the reference.
scenes.handoff: End at frame boundary 901: 30.033333 seconds at 30 fps.
scenes.review: A xem.email CTA would be a separate optional variation; the reference-matched master ends on the logo alone.
